items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I was playing with a fella called Doc... I was playing his band.

ctx.x: Did he ever work with you years ago or anything? No.

On Snap? No. In other words he just like a boss. He'd get the job. He'd be in the parade soon and have his little stick. Tell the boys what to play and all of them. And you know just like a grand marshal like that. He used to get all the jobs, get the wood. But one time he made a mess up at the Gordon District. He had two bands I was playing with playing too. I believe my band was in the front and he was behind. And he went and got that band. Called himself trying to do me a dirty trick. Something happened. I…
